description: Given a list of integers a, return true if there is an index i such that a[i] + 1 equals the next element a[i + 1] (two adjacent elements that are consecutive increasing integers), and false otherwise. Empty and single-element lists contain no such pair.
notes: VERINA: (exists i < |a| - 1, a[i] + 1 = a[i + 1]) <-> result. The Dafny spec states the existential through the recursive predicate HasConsecutivePair (with a {:fuel} hint) so that the verifier can evaluate it on the concrete test lists; it is equivalent to the quantified form used in the Python spec.
